lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill region. Spacing between centroids increases significantly along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a lattice-like arrangement of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with light-scattering on the upper edge and shadow-casting on the lower edge.
